subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Employee Appreciation Party
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce that our annual employee appreciation party will be held on Friday, December 10th at 6:00 PM in the office cafeteria. Join us for an evening of celebration, recognition, and fun activities. Please RSVP by November 30th so we can ensure there's enough food and drinks for everyone. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, [Your Company Name]
